thread:
zhen: Heads-up — I found a reproducible head-of-line stall in cont-batching when KV fragments are uneven across shards. Repro steps + logs below.

zhen: Repro: run ./bench --profile=kvcache-contbatch --seq=8192 --clients=64 --merge-policy=async
zhen: Behavior: one request in batch blocks ~150ms waiting on KV merge for a large fragment; others wait.

lucas: Can you paste the flamegraph or pprof output?

zhen: pprof snippet:
```
    40%  runtime.go:mergeFragment
    25%  scheduler.go:waitForKV
    15%  net.go:receive
    10%  contbatch.go:dispatch
```

maria: interesting — looks like mergeFragment holds the shard lock while doing IO/allocs.
maria: Could be fragmentation causing repeated slow merges on the hot-path.

aj: Any difference when you force-sync merges (sync merge) vs async?

zhen: yes — sync-merge moves latency to the originating client but avoids HOL. async-merge batches merges but sometimes a late big fragment stalls the whole batch.

perf-bot: perf-test #342 started (baseline vs patch). Link: https://ci/perf/342

lucas: Potential mitigations:
- limit async merge window per-batch (max-ms)
- prefetch/compact big fragments off the critical path
- try lock-free merge handoff (producer-consumer)

maria: I added a quick prototype that moves heavy compaction to a background worker and hands only a token to the batch. Initial run drops HOL occurrences by ~70%.
maria: Patch: `kvcache: handoff compaction to bg thread; leave token in batch` — pushed to repo.

aj: Can you drop the patch here? Also need regression test for long contexts (seq=16384)

zhen: Pushed link: https://git/repo/commit/abc123
zhen: Re-ran bench with seq=16384 clients=128: HOL events reduced from 8/1000 to 2/1000, memory growth stable.

lucas: Nice. One more thought — kernel selection interacts here because large-fragment merges can cause jitter and increase kernel preemption. Maybe limit expensive kernel paths during merge.

maria: Agree. Also add metric: kv_merge_duration_bucketed and batch_wait_for_merge_count. We can graph and set alert at >0.5% HOL rate.

aj: Assigning follow-ups:
- @maria: productionize handoff prototype + unit tests
- @zhen: add longctx perf regression test and perf-compare job
- @lucas: look at kernel selection knobs to reduce jitter

infra-bot: perf cluster snapshot saved to s3://perf-snapshots/2145123456.tar.gz :thumbsup:

zhen: Thanks — I'll create a short design doc tomorrow with microbench numbers.

maria: I'll add dashboards and an evaluator prompt set for long-contexts.

lucas: If anyone sees new HOL after prod rollout, ping #eng-runtime oncall and tag me.

aj: Great teamwork. :rocket:
